asked.item: Why a Greek reply under 8000 characters fails

verdict.reason: The help pages state that Facebook counts comment and public reply length in bytes, and that Greek text fails above about 4000 characters, which explains why a Greek reply under 8000 characters can still fail.

steps.text: Facebook limits a comment or public reply to 8000 bytes, not characters.
Greek text fails above about 4000 characters.
Because the limit counts bytes, Greek text can fail well before reaching 8000 characters.
Blotato's documentation says Facebook rejects a reply over 8000 bytes with a generic error.
